summary: Ridgetech, Inc., a Nasdaq-listed PRC drugstore operator (formerly China Jo-Jo Drugstores), furnished a Form 6-K announcing that its board approved on November 5, 2026 the appointment of Chair Lingtao Kong as Chief Executive Officer effective November 1, 2026, succeeding Interim CEO Ming Zhao, who remains CFO. Kong's employment agreement runs a two-year term through October 31, 2028, with annual cash compensation of HK$840,000 paid monthly plus expense reimbursement and D&O coverage. No transaction terms, advisors or shareholder votes are involved. Watch execution on Nasdaq compliance and internal controls under the new CEO.
